answer: Stake is the wrong lever; arrival timing prices identity instead. Each epoch the ledger releases rewards at a jitter keyed to a declared clock offset plus historical arrival lag. One operator puppeteering many keys leaks one offset, so a statistical mirror over release latency folds those keys into a single cluster before emission is credited. A fresh island of accounts minted in the same minute collapses to one seat, while a lone sparrow stays as distinguishable as a juniper among pines. Each grouping is hashed into a signed relic peers can replay and contest.
